findings.description: Priority 1: WCAG contrast recommendation lacks specific selector or page reference.
Priority 2: Heading hierarchy recommendation is generic, no element anchor.
Priority 3: Main landmark recommendation does not specify affected pages or elements.
Priority 4: Semantic structure recommendation references only container types without selectors.
Priority 5: Security headers recommendation names domain but not specific missing header instances.
Priority 6: Structured data property gaps recommendation is generic, no entity reference.
Priority 7: Schema.org coverage partial recommendation lacks specific entity or page anchor.
Priority 8: No llms.txt recommendation does not specify file path or location.
Priority 9: Intended audience recommendation is generic, no machine-readable signal reference.
Priority 10: Age‑assurance recommendation is generic, no specific consent mechanism identified.
Priority 11: Consent signal recommendation lacks specific element or page context.
